meta_description:
168 likes, 9 comments - tech_shuffle on October 1, 2026: "A Really Good Phone In This Price Hike Suitation 🔪

this didn’t just have a curved display, but also had a display on the back.

With this, you can check notifications, battery, charging status, volume, and even custom text and emojis without unlocking the phone.

The Lava Virat 5G comes with a 6.67-inch 3D curved AMOLED display, a 120Hz refresh rate, 10-bit colors, and 1100 nits of peak brightness, which stays crystal clear even outdoors.

For performance, you get the Dimensity 7100, 6GB of LPDDR5 RAM, and 128GB of storage. So, for daily use, multitasking, and gaming, this setup is quite capable.

For the camera, there’s a 50-megapixel Sony IMX766 sensor with EIS, and you can record videos in 4K. You also get modes like Pro Video, Night, Sports, and Dual View.

And there’s a massive 6000mAh battery with 45W charging.

But my favorite part is Android 16, without any bloatware or ads.

And this vegan leather back makes the phone feel even more premium.

Look, curved displays are available on a lot of phones these days, but this secondary display on the back makes this phone stand out and look much more noticeable.".
